definitions.text: An expression of inquiry or slight surprise.
A mineral of a green color and pearly luster; a hydrous phosphate of copper.

definitions.text: Of, pertaining to, or resembling, a horse. The shoulders, body, things, and mane are equine; the head completely bovine. Sir J. Barrow.
